properties.name: From the Signal Hill Road parking
properties.note: Up the gravel road from the boom, then the path that winds round the peak.

properties.name: From Kloof Nek
properties.note: Up the steps off Signal Hill Road, then the path that contours above the road to meet the gravel road.

properties.name: Chains and staples
properties.note: The direct way, over the chains and the steel staples beside them.

properties.name: Chains bypass
properties.note: Avoids the chains on the path round the Camps Bay side.
Up the zig-zag steps from the sharp bend in Tafelberg Road to the Contour Path at Kloof Corner.
Up the ridge to the Window and the 11 Inch Crack, then off the ridge to meet India Venster.
Up the Kloof Corner path, then round below Kloof Buttress and through the dassie traverse to Cairn Ravine.
Down Cairn Ravine to the Pipe Track.
From the Lower Cable Station up to the Contour Path, then 1 km east to Union Ravine.
Up Union Ravine and Yellowstone Gully, then the traverse across Right Face and through the tunnels to India Venster.
Down India Venster to the Lower Cable Station.
Up Platteklip Gorge from the parking to where the route leaves the zig-zags.
The cairned line left of Platteklip, then the 920 m ledge to the top.
Off the Contour Path by the triangular rock, up Silverstream Ravine, then the traverse ledge round to Ledges.
Down Ledges to the Saddle, then the Zig-Zag path to Tafelberg Road.
Up the Zig-Zag path to Saddle Rock, then beside the watercourse and up the old firebreak to the summit.
